prayerExcerpt.en-US: Benjamin, who was a minister of the Gospel, declared that he should miss no opportunity of announcing Christ.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Benjamim, que era um ministro do Evangelho, declarou que não perderia nenhuma oportunidade de anunciar Cristo.

meta.face: A Persian of about twenty-eight with a warm, light-brown complexion and a SOFT face with smooth, ROUND cheeks that fall away to a SHORT, gently RECEDING chin under a LONG, HIGH-BRIDGED, ARCHED nose — a smooth, rounded forehead, LARGE, dark, heavy-lidded almond eyes set WIDE apart, fine, HIGH-ARCHED black brows, a small, full, bow-shaped mouth; thick, glossy black hair in loose waves to the ears; only a first thin moustache and a sparse down of beard along the jaw; the gaze candid and ardent, toward us.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The Painter's Manual, among the holy deacons, gives 'Benjamin, a young man with an incipient beard' (feast 13 October, the Eastern date of this Benjamin, as Wikipedia confirms); the modern icon on Wikipedia shows a young, curly-haired deacon with a book. The book tells his year in prison, his release through the emperor's ambassador and his refusal to keep silent; its engraving shows him seated in his dungeon. The round-cheeked face with the long arched nose and receding chin is our choice.
